home.title: Koh Samui boat trips, island guide and parties
home.kp_faq:
~Is Ang Thong Marine Park open in November? | No. Ang Thong Marine Park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December for the monsoon and reopens on 16 December. Pig Island and Koh Tao trips run every day in that window, and Ang Thong dates from 16 December can be booked now.
~How do I get from Koh Samui to the Full Moon Party? | The simplest way is our shared return speedboat: hotel pickup on Koh Samui, a 30–45 minute crossing to Haad Rin and a return boat through the night, for 1,400 THB per person. Party entry of about 200 THB is paid at the gate.
When is the best time to visit Koh Samui? | February to April has the calmest sea and least rain, and is the best time for boat trips. May to September is also good because Samui is sheltered from the south-west monsoon. October to December is the rainy season, with November the wettest month.
Which areas of Koh Samui does your hotel pickup cover, and which cost extra? | Pickup is included from most areas, including Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Maenam, Choeng Mon and Bang Rak. Lipa Noi, Nathon, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut carry an extra 400 THB per person return on Chaweng-side departures; Pig Island trips leave from Thong Krut, so their zones differ.
Are prices charged in Thai baht? | Yes. Every booking is charged in Thai baht (THB). The EUR and USD prices you can switch to in the header are for reference only, converted at the day's rate.
What is your cancellation policy? | For day tours: full refund 48 hours or more before departure, 50% between 24 and 48 hours, and none under 24 hours or for a no-show. Ang Thong tours: full refund 48 hours or more before departure, none under 48 hours. If we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date.
